scene_context.physical_setting: Outdoor restaurant patio with wooden structures and greenery
scene_context.social_context: Public dining turning into a staged social performance (flash mob)
scene_context.emotional_atmosphere: Initially confused/awkward, transitioning to celebratory and romantic

characters.physical_description: Adult female, long curly hair, black sleeveless top, patterned pants

initial_state.body_language_summary: Slumped posture, chin resting on hand, gaze directed at smartphone, avoiding eye contact with environment
initial_state.apparent_goal: To disengage from the surrounding disturbance
behavioral_evidence: Scrolling on phone while waiters dance (00:25)
Furrowed brow and lack of orientation toward the commotion

final_state.body_language_summary: Standing, embracing partner, smiling broadly (Duchenne), open posture
final_state.apparent_goal: To accept the proposal and reciprocate affection

behavioral_evidence: Sudden orientation and recognition when partner joins dance (01:15)

initial_state.body_language_summary: Sitting stiffly, checking surroundings, preparing to move
behavioral_evidence: Standing up abruptly to join dancers (00:33)

desire_motivation_analysis.reasoning_chain: Subject perceives the flash mob as an external disturbance -> Displays withdrawal cues (phone usage, hand blocking view) -> Desire is to avoid the social disruption and maintain personal space.

supporting_evidence.description: Leans chin on hand, looking down at table/phone, physically closing off from the environment.
Fixated on smartphone screen despite loud music and movement nearby.

alternative_interpretations.reasoning: She looks tired/fatigued, which could explain the lack of engagement.
alternative_interpretations.why_not_primary: The active use of the phone suggests cognitive engagement elsewhere, rather than pure physiological rest.

desire_motivation_analysis.reasoning_chain: Subject notices partner is missing/dancing -> Expectation violation occurs -> Orienting response triggered to update belief state about the situation.

supporting_evidence.description: Head lifts, eyes widen, mouth opens slightly (surprise micro-expression).
Turns body fully toward the performance.

desire_motivation_analysis.reasoning_chain: Subject engages in choreographed dance -> Seeks to demonstrate effort and skill to the target -> Precursor to the proposal.

supporting_evidence.description: Executing synchronized dance moves with the group.
Lifting a female dancer (display of strength/skill).

desire_motivation_analysis.reasoning_chain: Subject recognizes the roses and the context -> Emotional valence shifts to high positive -> Engages in approach behavior (standing, hugging) to fulfill belonging needs.

supporting_evidence.description: Hands to face, wide smile, tears.
Extending hand to receive the ring.

trigger_event.description: The proposing_man becomes visible as a central participant in the dance.

behavioral_markers.description: Transition from neutral/annoyed expression to surprise and recognition.
Stops leaning on hand, sits upright.

desire_transitions.visual_marker_of_change: The exact moment she lifts her head from the phone, sees the man dancing, and her mouth opens in a smile of recognition.
desire_transitions.psychological_interpretation: A radical update in Belief state (from 'random noise' to 'meaningful signal') triggers a shift from Avoidance to Approach motivation.

trigger_event.description: proposing_man appears with a bouquet of red roses.

behavioral_markers.description: Standing up to meet the partner.

desire_transitions.visual_marker_of_change: The moment the roses are revealed, her hands fly to her face, indicating an emotional peak and recognition of the proposal intent.
desire_transitions.psychological_interpretation: The explicit cultural symbol (roses) confirms the Intention of the partner, shifting the woman's state to high-arousal belonging fulfillment.

behavioral_sequence.behavior_description: Chin resting on palm, eyes averted to phone screen, minimal reaction to surrounding noise.
behavioral_sequence.relevance_to_desire: Indicates a desire to avoid the current social environment (Safety/Comfort).
Signals acceptance of the social display and transition to Belonging needs.

behavioral_sequence.behavior_description: Kneeling on one knee, presenting ring box.
behavioral_sequence.relevance_to_desire: The definitive behavioral marker of Social_Commitment_Solicitation.

key_segments_for_qa.segment_description: The woman realizes her partner is part of the flash mob.
key_segments_for_qa.psychological_significance: Clear example of Belief revision leading to emotional state change (ToM).

key_segments_for_qa.segment_description: The woman ignores the flash mob while the man prepares to join.
key_segments_for_qa.psychological_significance: Demonstrates contrasting mental states (Ignorance vs. Intent) in a dyad.

inter_character_dynamics.mutual_influence: Initially disconnected (woman unaware, man hiding intent), transitioning to high mutual focus and emotional synchrony.

key_interaction_moments.description: Man leaves table while woman ignores him.
Visual reconnection when woman sees man dancing.

annotation_metadata.annotation_notes: The video clearly depicts a 'surprise' scenario, making the ToM distinction between the woman's knowledge state (ignorant) and the man's knowledge state (knowledgeable) very distinct in the first half.
